clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt provides the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial for research into decontamination. It is meant to siphon and contain unstable irradiated discharge from mutants deep inside Gnomeregan.

The Heavy Leaden Collection Phial draws volatile residue from living, irradiated creatures in Gnomeregan. Keeping the fallout contained is difficult, and a suitable sample may take several attempts to collect.

Ozzie Togglevolt provides the phial to support his research into reversing the horrific mutations afflicting leper gnomes. Earlier samples from surface troggs lacked the potency needed for effective chemical analysis. With the leaden phial, researchers hope to gather samples from virulent beasts such as irradiated slimes and lurkers in the Hall of Gears. They seek the active elements in the city's toxic fallout, then hope to formulate an effective antidote.
